name: edeka-shopping
description: Shop at EDEKA online markets in Germany (EDEKA, E center, some Marktkauf): market search, offers, basket by plain words, earliest pickup slot, order only after you confirm. Unofficial; runs locally with your own login.

interface.shortDescription: Shop EDEKA, E center and Marktkauf pickup from chat
interface.longDescription: Order groceries from EDEKA online markets (<market>.edeka.shop: EDEKA, E center and some Marktkauf stores) for pickup by chat or voice: find a market by postal code, see weekly offers, add products in plain words, get the earliest pickup slot and place the order only after you confirm total and slot. Uses the open-source edeka-pp-cli from the Printing Press library on your own computer; you log in to your market yourself in a browser window. Not affiliated with EDEKA.
